retrieval.assessment: The complete original sponsor announcement remains unchanged. It reports US Phase I initiation after IND clearance and describes planned single- and multiple-ascending oral doses in 86 participants with obesity or overweight. It still does not identify first dosing, recruitment status, locations or typed study dates. Animal bioavailability, half-life, weight and food-intake findings remain non-human evidence rather than human results.
